[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] Yep, before I knew how to use coins properly I'd accumulated $70 worth or more.
Look at the Extra Discount section in the Coins page. Sometimes they have genuine deals.
What I find has good deals are:
Apple Find My tags (with coins basically 4 for $10 delivered)
Android Find Hub tags (with coins basically 4 for $12 delivered)
ZigBee sensors (with coins can be as low as $1-2 each)
Key to maximise value is to buy items that are cheap and you can buy multiple of the exact same item to get the prediscount total to above $15. Then free delivery kicks in.
So for example Apple tags might be $10 each and 80% off with coins. That means if you buy two it'll be $20 pre discount triggering free delivery. Then you apply 80% off using coins ($8 coins per tag) which brings the tags to $2 each. Then you plus 10% tax based on the original RRP so that adds $1 each. Something like that. In the end you get two tags for $6 delivered after tax.
Also when you search in the coins page, scroll scroll scroll until you find the cheapest after coins discount. The prices vary significantly. Sometimes you find things stupidly cheap. E.g. I found water leak ZigBee sensors for around just over $1 each after tax and delivery. The battery they come with is worth at least 50c. Normally these sensors sell for $5+ each at the cheapest
